extraction.Name: Anna Blackbird
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 716639 issued under the 'Declaration of Policy.' Application for patent in fee signed by Anna Blackbird before E. E. Empey, Notary Public, on April 18, 1918. Letter dated February 5, 1929, from Superintendent E. E. McKean to Commissioner of Indian Affairs; refers to Circular 2464, agency letter of December 11, 1928, and Office letter of January 5, 1929. Superintendent inquired whether the Office desired information called for in Circular No. 2464 in this case.
